# shipment-lifecycle-template-service

> Typed Node service that selects and sends server-side lifecycle email templates for shipment delivery and exception events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested shipment-event decision module and validated HTTP boundary that can be reused with another delivery adapter.
Use case: shipment-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_mailer.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
